input: Any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path must also set /turn/ply.num to the current ply and must be co-signed by at least twelve other Black agents' keys, so that a stale or off-plan move cannot be accepted for the wrong ply.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false)
